liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Beautifully played jam and effortless segue into Wharf Rat, which is itself incredible; the Dancing sandwich is the show's highlight [15]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Played well, then drifts into a spacey jam where Garcia uses a wah effect before The Other One [6]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Called a great closer to the set [6]

## The recordings

- **gd76-10-10.hollwein.vernon.11670.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 166 min; rated 4.4/5 by 10 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording isn't the clearest in the archive but is quite listenable, especially on good speakers [15]
- **gd76-10-10.sbd.clugston.3381.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 157 min; rated 4.17/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard sounds excellent: Garcia's guitar is loud and forward in the mix, and the drummers don't dominate [5]
- **gd1976-10-10.155765.aud.wizardo.miller.flac1644**: audience recording; 23 songs; 171 min [3]
- **gd1976-10-10.155807.sony-ecm-220-ecm-280.holwein.sirmick.remaster.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 169 min [4]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bill Graham [1]
- The Dead warmed up for The Who at this show, and reviewer notes the two bands were apparently friends [6]
- Attendee in 1976 went for The Who, and this was their first Dead show, which made them a lifelong fan [16]
- Reviewer says the same praise applies to the previous day's show, which they also call a classic [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-10-10.hollwein.vernon.11670.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Recorded by Reinhardt Hollwein with Sony ECM-220 and ECM-280 mics into a Sony TC-15, via JackySack; seeded by Matt Vernon [1]
- **gd76-10-10.sbd.clugston.3381.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1976-10-10.155765.aud.wizardo.miller.flac1644**: taped by John Wizardo; transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 16, 2022; source: (FOB) Unknown Mics > Cassette Master (Uher Deck) [3]. Also: Audio came via Steve Anderson and Matt Day; patch source was Hollwein's recording, pitch-matched to the main source [3]
- **gd1976-10-10.155807.sony-ecm-220-ecm-280.holwein.sirmick.remaster.flac16**: taped by Reinhardt Hollwein; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: Sony ECM-220 + Sony ECM-280 > Sony TC-15 > Master Audio Casstte - Recorded by Reinhardt Hollwein [4]. Also: Remaster of shn 11670 from JackySack's CDs given to Matt Vernon; pitch corrected, with azimuth and phase adjustments; Patches fill the gap between Brown Eyed Women and Playing In The Band, and a spot in Stella Blue [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Snooky Flowers Grateful Dead: [1976-10-09 Oakland-Alameda County Stadium, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1976-10-09-oakland-alameda-county-stadium-oakland-ca-usa/) [18]
- Fan art by Schneider Photography Store: [Grateful Dead - Oakland Coliseum, Oakland, CA - 10-10-76](https://schneiderphotographystore.com/products/grateful-dead-oakland-coliseum-oakland-ca-9-10-1976) [19]
